'''Gideon Faun''' is a [[peddler]] who sells his wares around [[Almoth Plain]] and [[Toman Head]].
== History ==
On the road near [[Aturo's Orchard]], Faun was attacked by a band of [[Children of the Light]] raiding the area, although they were disguised as [[Tarabon]]ers.<ref name="RPG">''[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game]]''</ref>
